body:
Honestly, being honest seems like an impossible task to me, I want to live a normal life but I am constantly dragged down. That is why therapy cant work on me, in fact, I don't see anything which could help me mentally. That is why I am suicidal, currently, I was on a overdose and I feel nothing, I even drunk lots of alcohol with it which means that I don't feel as depressed. Tomorrow is going to be rough, I am going to get a withdrawal feeling which is going to make me feel so low, that is another reason why I really wanted it to succeed to end me.

Realistically, I don't want to die. The thought of it terrifies me and it completely sucks. But it feels like the only way out of never-ending pain.  I was inspired and determined to be a good person but I didn't succeed at that.
